title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Exodus 23: laws on justice and the feasts, and God's promise to send his angel before Israel.

questions.text: What must you do if you meet your enemy's ox or donkey going astray?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says that if you meet your enemy's ox or donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

answers.text: Keep it until he asks for it

questions.text: What reason does verse 8 give for not taking a bribe?
questions.explanation: A bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

answers.text: It brings a plague on the camp
It blinds those who have sight

questions.text: Why were the Israelites not to oppress an alien?
questions.explanation: They knew the heart of an alien, since they had been aliens in the land of Egypt.

answers.text: They had been aliens in the land of Egypt
They had been aliens in the land of Canaan
They had been aliens in Midian
They had been aliens in the wilderness of Sinai

questions.text: In the seventh year the land had to rest and lie fallow. Who would eat from it?
questions.explanation: The land was to lie fallow so that the poor of the people could eat, and the animals of the field would eat what they left.

questions.text: In which month was the feast of unleavened bread to be kept?
questions.explanation: The feast was to be kept at the appointed time in the month Abib, because in it Israel came out of Egypt.

questions.text: What does verse 19 say you must not boil in its mother's milk?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says: "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk."

questions.text: Why were the people not to provoke the angel God would send before them?
questions.explanation: God said the angel would not pardon their disobedience, for God's name was in him.

answers.text: He would go back and leave them alone
He would not pardon their disobedience
He would lead them back to Egypt
He would hide the way from them

questions.text: What did God say he would send to drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite and the Hittite?
questions.explanation: God said: "I will send the hornet before you," which would drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite and the Hittite.

questions.text: Why would God not drive out the nations in one year?
questions.explanation: He would not drive them out in one year, lest the land become desolate and the animals of the field multiply against Israel. He would drive them out little by little.

answers.text: Because Israel had too few weapons
Because the tabernacle had not been built yet
Because the kings of the land would make peace
So the land would not become desolate and the wild animals multiply

questions.text: God would set Israel's border from the Red Sea to which sea?
questions.explanation: Verse 31 says the border would run from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River.
